authorization_basis: User delegated the four pending scope, semantics, numeric domain and responsibility/environment decisions in this chat on 2026-10-19.

qualification_slice.entry: Core.run with injected public validator; mocked upstream for present offline qualification
qualification_slice.data: public synthetic fixtures and bounded in-memory SQLite

numeric_domain.amount_type: integer or NULL; no inferred currency/unit conversion
numeric_domain.customer_and_order_id: unique non-NULL signed int64 within each table; zero and negatives remain valid
numeric_domain.customer_reference: signed int64 or NULL; absent referenced customers remain valid
numeric_domain.overflow_or_out_of_domain: reject before model dispatch under a new enforced contract; never clamp, drop rows or change expected values

semantics.S01: SUM all orders including void; ignore NULL; empty/all NULL returns NULL
semantics.S02: paid orders with ISO date >=2026-01-01 and <2026-02-01; NULL dates excluded; ascending id; other periods require their own frozen contract
semantics.S03: paid orders by customer including NULL and undeclared customer groups; COUNT includes NULL amounts; retain duplicate values
semantics.S04: all declared customers, paid order count, zero if none; ignore NULL/undeclared foreign keys; ascending signed id
semantics.S05: declared customers with no matching paid orders; NULL foreign key matches nobody, including customer id zero
semantics.S06: paid order groups including NULL and undeclared customers; amount DESC with NULL last, then id ASC; all NULL still selects smallest id
semantics.S07: paid orders by customer; day ASC NULL first then id ASC; NULL amount contributes zero; cumulative through current row; equivalent SQL allowed
semantics.S08: distinct text union; NULL once; empty string preserved; BINARY case-sensitive comparison and ordering; no trimming or normalization

date_domain: valid proleptic Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD calendar dates, years 0001..9999, or NULL; no timestamps/timezone conversion

responsibility.technical_decision_owner: Codex AI assistant under explicit delegation

environment.development: existing macOS portable worker for offline synthetic tests only
environment.production_qualification_target: Linux isolated SQL worker with independently demonstrated total-process memory, CPU, external deadline, file and network restrictions
environment.exact_build_pin: freeze actual kernel, interpreter/SQLite and isolation artifact digests before qualification; no deployed artifact selected or verified in this decision
environment.local_only_claim: not granted by choosing Linux or local model backend
